endorsements.label: Exploring the MediaTek Baseband
endorsements.description: Cellular communications and baseband have always been obscure and not publicly explored topics, until the very last couple of years where more public research has surfaced. The Cellular modem are an interesting remote attack surface and they lack often of modern mitigations, making them an attractive target for a "0-click" compromise over the air. Read more
